# .github/workflows/build-images.yml) must NOT treat as a leak. Consumed via `grep -vFxf`:
# whole-line, fixed-string. One exact string per line; the `#` header/annotation lines below are
# inert (a comment line is never whole-line-equal to a secret-shaped scan hit).

# example inside the flake.lock-pinned hermes-agent closure — not real keys. The tightened
# scan-2 pattern still matches any real sk-/ghp_ token (a real token is not whole-line-equal to
# these placeholders), so this allowlist weakens detection of zero real keys.
#

# GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN: "ghp_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"   (MCP-server env example)
